obligations.behavior: Elaborate and synthesize cleanly across equal-width, upsize, and downsize ratios with FORWARD_ID in {0,1} and multi-bit USER buses, driving full-width zeros when disabled and maintaining cycle-accurate RTL-to-gate-level parity with zero latches.
Step slave addresses per AXI4 FIXED, INCR, and WRAP rules across full-width, narrow, and unaligned transfers and steer WDATA/WSTRB and RDATA byte lanes accurately.

Repack qualifying upsize bursts (CONVERT_BURST, cache[1], CONVERT_NARROW_BURST or full-size, INCR or qualifying WRAP) to aligned full-width master INCR bursts with exact m_axi_a*len and WLAST/RLAST framing, passing all other bursts through unmodified.

Pass narrow downsize bursts through unmodified, split wide bursts into master INCR child bursts respecting unaligned start offsets, FIXED per-beat splits, WRAP boundaries, and 256-beat caps, and propagate highest-severity RRESP and BRESP/BUSER.
